words.example: I attach the log for completeness.
Please reply at your earliest convenience.
Send the list by close of business.
words.exampleZh: 请在下班前把名单发来。

words.example: Bring the meeting-room keys back by end of day, please.
words.exampleZh: 请在当天结束前把会议室钥匙还回来。

words.example: At the start of day, make sure every counter has coins for change.
words.exampleZh: 当天开始时，请确认每个柜台都备有零钱。

words.example: The control plane is healthy again, and new pods are scheduling normally.
words.exampleZh: 控制平面已经恢复，新容器组正在正常调度。

words.example: That worker node ran out of disk, so image pulls for the lab pods failed.
words.exampleZh: 那台工作节点磁盘满了，检验容器组拉取镜像因此失败。

words.example: We restored etcd from the 02:00 snapshot after the control plane disk filled.
words.exampleZh: 控制平面的磁盘写满之后，我们用凌晨两点的快照恢复了集群键值库。

words.example: The scheduler kept placing both database pods on one worker until we set a rule.
words.exampleZh: 在我们加规则之前，调度器一直把两个数据库容器组放在同一台工作节点上。

words.example: The kubelet on worker six stopped reporting, and that node went NotReady.
words.exampleZh: 六号工作节点上的节点代理停止上报后，该节点变成了 NotReady。
